time_mapping: Q1 periodic representative day only: source_minute modulo 1440; sort ascending; each sample held over following 10 minutes; no rotation of dated actual data
working_assumptions: External-side metering and fixed Q1 6000 endpoints are explicit trial conditions from prior recommendations; user authorized actual comparison, not a fabricated separate parameter approval. PV first serves load; no export, cycling fee or emergency fee; no simultaneous positive charging/discharging in accepted schedules.
grid_rule: 27 settings for each of 03 and 10, exact paired parameters; tariff quantiles use known representative-day prices; low charge requires p_now < eta_charge*eta_discharge*max_later_price_at_deficit; PV surplus charging takes priority; high discharge uses available battery; terminal-reachability projection identical for both rules
reserve_rule: 10 only: before the next contiguous PV-surplus episode, reserve internally storable energy (charge-power-limited) less potential high-price discharge before that episode, clamp to usable capacity; reduce target to max(min_kwh,max_kwh-reserve). All other logic matches 03.
primary_selection: For each rule choose minimum unrounded cost over the 27 settings; ties break by parameter index. Also evaluate 10 at 03-selected parameters and report all 27 paired changes; this is same-day planning/tuning, not independent test/generalization.
lp: scipy.optimize.linprog HiGHS; grid-to-charge, PV-to-charge, discharge and end-of-slot storage continuous; exact energy balances and charge limit; discharge limited by residual load; fixed endpoints; positive-price structure precludes simultaneous optimal grid charging/discharging
budget: 54 deterministic rule evaluations + one LP; one full reproduction for audit; small hand-check examples and independent source/export/primal-dual checks. No new candidates, physical parameter sensitivity or full-year evaluation. At most one implementation repair rerun, preserve failed outputs.
outputs: All rule schedules and parameter scores, LP schedule and certificate, selected schedules, 4-hour summaries, input/template mapping audit, readable comparison, paper evidence, up to two reproducible result figures
stop: Explain actual comparison and recommend a main model; wait for user selection. No Q1 freeze, Q2 work, official template filling or final paper writing.
